intro: Use reproduce.csv (annual means) in a spreadsheet or Python. Record the conditions you used; the validator checks the number and the method.
steps: Find the CO2_ppm values for 1959 and 1971.
Percent change = (1971 − 1959) ÷ 1959 × 100. Keep at least 2 decimals.
For the growth rate, take the 2024 and 2014 values and divide their difference by 10 (the number of yearly steps from 2014 to 2024).
rounding: Do not round intermediate results. A result is VALID when |your value − reference| ≤ tolerance.
